meta.title: FINALS HQ · THE FINALS leaderboards and profiles
meta.description: Leaderboards, profiles and progression of THE FINALS players, tracked every 10 minutes. Fan project, not affiliated with Embark Studios.
meta.leaderboardDescription: THE FINALS {board} leaderboard ({season}): rank, score and progression of every player, sortable and filterable.
meta.playerDescription: {name}: {rank} on the {season} Ranked Cashout leaderboard, {score} RS, {league}. Chart, activity and career on FINALS HQ.
meta.playerDescriptionNone: {name}: chart, activity and career in THE FINALS public leaderboards, on FINALS HQ.

common.unknownHint: Unknown value: not enough history to compute it.
common.deducedHint: Approximation computed by FINALS HQ, not data published by Embark.
common.notAffiliated: Fan project, not affiliated with Embark Studios. THE FINALS is a trademark of Embark Studios AB.
common.source: Data: public leaderboards via api.the-finals-leaderboard.com, tracked every 10 minutes.

freshness.stale: Last snapshot {age}. Leaderboards may have moved since.
freshness.outdated: Last snapshot {age}: collection looks interrupted, showing the last known data.
freshness.rejected: Recent files were rejected (API format changed?).

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.loadError: Could not load the full leaderboard.
leaderboard.emptyHint: Try another league or club tag.
leaderboard.emptyBoard: This leaderboard is empty for now.
leaderboard.archived: Season over: final standings{date, select, none {} other { (snapshot of {date})}}.
leaderboard.pageIntro: Current season tracked every 10 minutes, past seasons frozen at their last snapshot.

search.title: Search
search.label: Embark name (e.g. GOJO#6255)
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters. Typos are tolerated from 3.
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} for “{q}”
search.noneHint: This player may not be in the top 10,000: public leaderboards stop there.
search.paletteHint: Ctrl K or ⌘ K to open, Esc to close
search.error: Search is not responding. Try again in a moment.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches in a row. Try again in a minute.

home.title: Find a player, follow the season.
home.intro: The top 10,000 ranked players of THE FINALS, tracked every 10 minutes.
home.top500Hint: RS of the 500th player, the bar to clear for the top of the board.
home.moversEmpty: 7-day change shows up after one week of tracking (since 5 Nov 2026).
home.distributionHint: Players per division at the last snapshot; the league comes from the API.

status.title: Data status
status.intro: The pipeline: the collector polls the API every 10 minutes, the worker loads it into the database, the site reads the database.

player.hidden: Profile hidden at the player's request.
player.notFoundHint: No player with this name was seen in public leaderboards. Check the name and its 4 digits.

errors.title: Data temporarily unavailable
errors.body: The database is not responding. The last computed pages are still served; try again in a minute.
errors.notFoundBody: This address does not match any FINALS HQ page.

profile.noPlatformHint: The leaderboard gives no Steam, PSN or Xbox name for this player.
profile.activeRecently: active less than an hour ago
profile.inactive: {days, plural, one {inactive for # day} other {inactive for # days}}
profile.chartEmpty: Not enough snapshots for this period yet (first seen {date}). Come back tomorrow, or pick “Season”.
profile.kpiDaysObserved: {count, plural, one {# day observed out of 7} other {# days observed out of 7}}
profile.ratingBody: The score out of 99 (level, peak, momentum, consistency, legacy) appears after a week of real data, once the population references are measured. Method in phase D.
profile.activityHint: Days your RS changed (one change can bundle several matches between two snapshots). Collected since {date}.
profile.heatDay: {date}: {count, plural, =0 {no RS change} one {# RS change} other {# RS changes}}
profile.whereHint: Top 10,000 players per division at the last snapshot; the league comes from the API. Your division is circled.
profile.notInTopBody: Public leaderboards stop at 10,000 players ({value} RS at the last snapshot). Beyond that, nobody's score is visible.
profile.neverSeenLive: Not seen on the {season} ranked leaderboard since collection started ({date}).
profile.followToKnow: Follow this player: they will show up on your Following page as soon as they get in.

career.badgeFirst: {count, plural, one {#1 of a season} other {#1 of # seasons}}
career.badgeSeasons: {count, plural, one {# ranked season} other {# ranked seasons}}
career.legacyExplain: {points} career points: 100 per season finished in the top 500 (+40 top 100, +60 #1), 60 in Diamond, 30 in Platinum, 10 for being in the top 10,000.
career.legacyScale: Legacy = 100 × (1 − e^(−points/250)): every season counts, with diminishing returns. It is 5% of the upcoming Rating.
career.noLeaguesHint: Betas, S1 and S2: no comparable league system, the season counts as a presence.
career.noRanked: Not in the top 10,000 of this season's ranked leaderboard.
career.coverage: Finished seasons from the public archives ({archived} ranked leaderboards). Before 4-digit names, a season is linked only when the name matches exactly.
career.empty: No past season in the archives
career.emptyHint: This player does not appear on any finished leaderboard under this name (top 10,000 of each season).

follow.hint: Add this player to your Following page (stored in your browser).
follow.full: List full (50 players) or browser storage refused.

following.title: Followed players
following.intro: Your list lives in your browser: no account, nothing stored on our side. Export it to use it on another device.
following.emptyHint: Open a profile and tap ☆ Follow: the player will show up here with their rank and today's change.
following.loadError: Could not load the players. Try again in a moment.
following.stored: {count, plural, one {# player stored in your browser} other {# players stored in your browser}} (50 max).
following.imported: {count, plural, =0 {No new player} one {# player added} other {# players added}}
following.importError: Unreadable file: pick a FINALS HQ export.
